dogecoin.text: To the @dogecoin_devs and @elonmusk . Our first steps towards improving DogeCoin use cases: Introduction "DogeID" to the world. We added the option to AntumID Multichain Authenticator. All based on #DigiID @DigiByteCoin Blockchain Technology. https://t.co/jy2639BnW3

OK, lets talk. @elonmusk thx for the reply. All the things you need are in the DigiByte blockchain, DigiShield is already into Dogecoin. We will add DogeID into AntumID Multichain Authentication or just use DigiByte Blockchain. @DigiByteCoin

With all respect for @dogecoin take a look at @DigiByteCoin May we ask you why you haven't looked in DigiByte yet? DGB helped doge at the time, don't forget that. As a partner we would like to support the DigiByte community! Take a look at the project. You will be amazed.
